headline: 'While saying they'll stop share price suppression…' Why Rep. Lee So-young is angry at the government's tax reform plan [Na Yu-jeong]
summary: Democratic Party lawmaker Lee So-young criticised the government's tax reform plan, citing inheritance tax differences between unlisted and listed companies. She referenced last year's anti-share price suppression law.
why: Inheritance and corporate tax rules affect share valuations, ownership transfers and corporate governance decisions in listed firms.
